name: chat-completions.idempotency_conflict.after_timeout
description: The first attempt timed out (gateway abort, or a reset after bytes were sent): an unknown outcome, so it settled at the FULL reservation (700 credits here, not the 42 an answer would have cost), not as failed_no_usage. The same-key retry therefore gets idempotency_conflict with state=settled. Only an explicit upstream error response or a connection failure before the request was accepted is failed_no_usage.

messages.content: Answer from the provided course passages.

error.message: A request with this key was already settled.
